blocks.text: Having lived through the vibrant, turn-of-the-millennium alternative rock era, I know exactly what it feels like when nostalgia and pure sonic aggression collide. The late ’90s and early 2000s were defined by a rebellious sub-genre that purists loved to hate but the masses couldn’t resist: nu-metal. Fast forward to the present day, and the unexpected duo of genre-blurring artist MGK (Colson Baker) and the undisputed king of the red cap himself, Fred Durst, has joined forces to unleash a powerhouse collaborative single titled “Fix Ur Face”.
